name: Chikansha Thomas
source:
Tohyama Masuo, who was called Thomas, was dull guy and out of work. When he was going to look for the job, he met Tachibana Ayane, a woman of his type, in a crowded train. Her refreshing smell made him so excited that he found himself touching her on her hip. This was the beginning of his pervert activities. With his technique, he gave sexual pleasure to women all over the place.
(taken from Animenfo)

The title is a play on the japanese name of the children's series 'Thomas the Tank Engine'. Rather than being 機関車トーマス 'Kikansha Thomas' (Locomotive or lit. Engine-car) this is 痴漢者トーマス 'Chikansha Thomas' (lit. Molester-man).

[From [url=http://anidb.net/a2603]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
被人称作托马斯的远山益夫是个迟钝而失业的男人。一天，他外出找工作，在拥挤电车上遇见了完全符合自己喜好的女性立花绫音。她身上清新的气味让益夫异常兴奋，回过神来时，他已经把手放在了她的臀部。这成为他一系列变态行为的开端。凭借自己的技巧，他在各处带给女性性快感。
（摘自AnimeNfo）

标题是对儿童系列《托马斯小火车》日文名的文字游戏。原名是“機関車トーマス”（Kikansha Thomas，意为机车托马斯），本作则改为“痴漢者トーマス”（Chikansha Thomas，意为痴汉托马斯）。
